search_text: published ZDI-12-133 ZDI-CAN-1377 GE Proficy Historian ihDataArchiver.exe Multiple Opcode Parsing Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities 2012-08-03 CVE-2012-0229 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2012-0229 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['GE'] ['Proficy Historian ihDataArchiver'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of GE iFix. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ihDataArchiver.exe process which listens by default on TCP port 14000. Several errors are present in the code responsible for parsing data from the network. By providing malformed data for opcodes 6, 7, 8, 10, and 12 the process can be made to corrupt memory which can lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the user running the service. GE has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
